deployFunds(address,uint256).details: Only callable by addresses with MANAGER_ROLEPulls funds from Vault via invest(), then transfers to destination

params.amount: The amount of assets to deploy
params.destination: The whitelisted address to receive funds

params.destination: The address to recall all funds from

returns._0: The amount of assets deployed to the destination
True if the address is whitelisted, false otherwise

pause().details: Only callable by addresses with ADMIN_ROLE

recallFunds(address,uint256).details: Only callable by addresses with MANAGER_ROLEDestination must have approved Engine to transfer, or use push pattern

params.amount: The amount of assets to recall
params.destination: The address to recall funds from

removeFromWhitelist(address).details: Only callable by addresses with ADMIN_ROLECannot remove if funds are still deployed to destination

params.destination: The address to remove from whitelist

settleLoss(uint256).details: Only callable by addresses with REPORTER_ROLECalls reportLoss() on Vault to adjust NAV (NO FEE)

params.lossAmount: The amount of loss to report

settleProfit(uint256).details: Only callable by addresses with REPORTER_ROLEProfit must be backed by actual assets in EngineTransfers profit to Vault, then calls reportProfit()

params.profitAmount: The amount of profit to report

unpause().details: Only callable by addresses with ADMIN_ROLE

addToWhitelist(address).notice: Add an address to the whitelist of allowed investment destinations

deployFunds(address,uint256).notice: Deploy funds from Engine to a whitelisted destination

emergencyRecall(address).notice: Emergency recall of all funds from a destination

getDeployedTo(address).notice: Get the amount of assets deployed to a specific destination

getTotalDeployed().notice: Get the total amount of assets deployed across all destinations

isPaused().notice: Check if the contract is currently paused

isWhitelisted(address).notice: Check if an address is on the whitelist

pause().notice: Pause all fund movements in case of emergency

recallFunds(address,uint256).notice: Recall funds from a destination back to the Engine

removeFromWhitelist(address).notice: Remove an address from the whitelist

unpause().notice: Resume normal operations after a pause
